_doc: Threshold strategy parameters. dB values are DEVICE dB (0 dB = brightest increment the device can show) unless the key ends in Hfa (HFA-equivalent dB). 'zest' = ZEST padrão (parada DP < 1,5 dB, aprovado). 'zestFast' = ZEST rápido (DP < 2,0 dB, prior normal mais estreito), opcional. Default = 'zest' (aprovado 2026-10-17).

fullThreshold._doc: OPI FT: 4-2 staircase, second staircase if the first result differs from the start estimate by more than retestIfDiffersByDb.

growth._doc: Start values / priors of non-anchor points are shifted by the mean total deviation of already finished neighbours (within the grid's neighbourRadiusDeg).
